summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) student composition wait states on ?preview=writing and (2) Teacher Review four-question mirror on ?review. All three primary acceptance signals from the review request PASS. Backend was intentionally skipped per request.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicPreview.jsx MetacognitionCue is well-structured: uses metacognitionSequence() with toFocus flag, rotates lines every 4.8s, holds on the final focus line when bridging. Language is genuine writer-thinking (thesis, evidence, conclusion, revision) — no 'I'm analyzing' AI-narration.

TeacherReview.jsx correctly renders all four Q blocks (what-focus, why, review-architecture list, review-next-step) when Stage B data is present. Verified across students A, B, C; every case populated all four blocks.
MongoDB _id concerns not applicable — no direct API responses inspected here (backend was pre-verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (writing wait-state + Teacher Review four-question mirror both fully verified)

test_credentials: None required (public preview URL, no login).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed WORKING on live preview URL: (a) ?preview=writing full flow — Welcome → Continue → Your Assignment textarea → Continue to Writing → writing textarea → Share button submits draft. Immediately after submit: preview-thinking-cue with -line appears (~t+2.5s) with pure writer-metacognition text ('Good writers read their own draft as a stranger would…'). preview-noticing-observation-1 arrives ~t+7.6s. preview-thinking-with with -line then rotates through 4 distinct writer-thinking lines (thesis anticipation, evidence, conclusion, focus bridge — 'I'm looking for where a little focused work will help your writing grow the most.'). Final coaching content is rendered on-screen (visible as 'YOUR COACH' panels — the full Stage B instructional response with essay-architecture framing) but there is no [data-testid='preview-message'] / 'preview-coaching' testid on the final coaching container; only observed via visible text. Not an acceptance failure per the review request. (b) ?review — 6 sample students; clicked A, B, C. review-explanation renders 'What developmental focus did Compass choose?' + 'Why was that focus selected…' + review-architecture (list) + review-next-step (string) on ALL three cases tested. No console errors, no page errors during either flow.

signals_verified.metacognition_cue_visible_during_wait: preview-thinking-cue-line visible at t+2.5s, preview-thinking-with-line at t+5s+, 4 distinct writer-thinking lines observed
signals_verified.cue_text_is_writer_metacognition_not_ai_: Confirmed — lines are about thesis, evidence, conclusion, drafting; none say 'I'm analyzing' or narrate Compass reasoning
signals_verified.teacher_review_four_question_mirror: All 4 Q blocks (what-focus, why, review-architecture, review-next-step) rendered for Students A, B, C

optional_case_status: TEACHER REFLECTION (?preview=teacher) not exercised — requires a full ~60s LLM turn behind the teacher simulation. Review request explicitly allowed skipping this since backend data was already verified.
